reviews.title: Had high expectations, and they were surpassed
reviews.comment:
I was running a xeon 2667 v3 and my old cooler was providing idle temperatures around 45 degrees celcius.  Under stress test the cpu was getting up over 90 degrees celcius.  I installed this cooler last night, and my idle temperatures on the xeon are now in the high 20's and under load, the cpu only gets up into the 50s.  Incredible difference.
the installation was a little challenging, only because this was my first time installing a tower cooler on any pc.  This comes with good instructions and good packaging.  It has several different brackets, I used the one for 2011 socket, and it fits wonderfully.
I have to recommend this, I was hoping for a 10 degree cooldown, but I got 20 degrees cooler instead for the idle temps.
This is doing a fantastic job
reviews.author: TSimmonsJr
